Jamstack Roadmap for 2024

The tooling, services, and patterns I am betting on for next year's Jamstack projects.

Jamstack is shifting toward edge rendering and composable commerce. This roadmap shares the platform choices I recommend to clients, plus the experiments I am running with partial hydration and edge data caches. Expect quarterly updates as the ecosystem evolves.
